name: Aquaguard Enrich Crest Hot UV
summary: Aquaguard Enrich Crest Hot is a premium inline UV water purifier designed for municipal water (TDS up to 200 mg/L).
intro: The Aquaguard Enrich Crest Hot is a premium inline UV water purifier designed for municipal water with TDS up to 200 mg/L. Featuring Patented Active Copper Technology, UV E-Boiling, Mineral Guard, and Mineral Magnet, it delivers safe, mineral-rich drinking water while retaining essential nutrients. With hot and warm water dispensing, Touch Sense controls, Health Protect Technology, and a sleek wall-mounted design, it combines advanced purification with modern convenience for contemporary kitchens.
features: Patented Active Copper Technology for copper-enriched water
Touch Sense Technology for effortless operation
Health Protect Technology with filter replacement alerts
High dispensing rate of up to 2 L/min
Sleek, wall-mounted inline design with concealable installation
